thought.text: Frontend no longer logs the DNS error. Let me verify the full end-to-end flow through Caddy.

action.command:
CADDY_IP=$(docker inspect -f '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}' qonnectra_caddy_dev)
echo "=== app root ==="; docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -sk --resolve app.localhost:443:$CADDY_IP -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://app.localhost/
echo "=== app /map (login page content) ==="; docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -sk --resolve app.localhost:443:$CADDY_IP https://app.localhost/map | head -c 500; echo
echo "=== api schema ==="; docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:$CADDY_IP -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://api.localhost/api/v1/schema/
echo "=== admin ==="; docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -sk --resolve admin.localhost:443:$CADDY_IP -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://admin.localhost/admin/login/
